  <div class="tab-pane fade" id="nav-syamilaka-life" role="tabpanel">
  Śyāmilaka is a Sanskrit poet who is believed to have lived during the 9th century CE. He is known for his work Pādatāḍitaka, a collection of 64 verses that serve as examples of different meters and poetic forms used in Sanskrit poetry. While not much is known about Śyāmilaka's life, he is known to be a native of Northern India and the son of Viśveśvaradatta.
